## The IRTc construction

$$P(Y_i \le y_i \mid \theta_i) = C_\theta\!\big(F_1(y_{i1} \mid \theta_i, \xi_1), \ldots, F_J(y_{iJ} \mid \theta_i, \xi_J);\ \delta\big)$$

*Item-response marginals $F_j$ separated from the dependence structure
$C_\theta$ with parameters $\delta$; copula placement options (among observed
responses conditional on $\theta$, among latent response variables, among
latent dimensions, among residuals, among testlet effects).*

## Conventional IRT located within IRTc

*The independence copula recovers local-independence IRT (Level 1 of the model
ladder — the product-copula wrapper with its numerical-tolerance acceptance
test). For each conventional model, classify the relationship: exact
equivalence, approximation, or analogy — nothing stronger than what is proved.*

## Parameter interpretation under dependence

*What difficulty, discrimination, guessing, and thresholds mean when dependence
is no longer Gaussian or product-form; when a copula parameter is a substantive
estimand vs a nuisance parameter for fit; whether any Rasch-style invariance
survives restricted copula families.*
